title: Business Analyst
text: Business Analyst at DHL Supply Chain (Australia) Pty Ltd (Sydney, Parramatta & Western Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). DHL Supply Chain offers a challenging yet exciting place to work where every day we ask you to be the best that you can be. In return we offer an excellent working environment and the security of working with the world's foremost logistics solutions provider! Our People Are Our Greatest Strength and we are looking for an exceptional Business Analyst to join our Technology & Service Logistics sector in the Western suburbs. Your demonstrated analytical skills will see you lead and identify process improvements & innovative solutions creating a more productive, cost effective and profitable enterprise. Exceptional MS Office skills and excellent communication will see you succeed in this varied role. Duties Analysis and reporting of performance – develop automated reporting formats Detailed data analysis on SKU behaviour to optimise productivity in an automated picking system Proactive Qualitative analysis and business Insight Numerical analysis of raw data into accurate reports Analytical problem solving and system planning; identifying opportunities for improvement Daily interaction with internal and external stakeholders Plan and assist in ensuring customers efficiencies are improved and maximised Skills and Experience Advanced MS Office; specifically MS Excel and MS and Access 3+ years' experience in business analysis or process analysis Highly developed written and verbal communication skills Demonstrated experience using Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) - Manhattan Experience within an automated retail warehouse solution Advanced analytical & problem solving skills Experience within a 3PL environment and good warehouse knowledge Self-motivation and ability to work independently Analytical and operational reasoning with the aability to generate and support innovation Personal resilience. Able to sustain a high level of energy and positivity during pressure How To Apply Click APPLY to submit your application or email your application to dsc.recruitment@dhl.com
